earth_timeline.label: First neutron star mergers begin enriching the galaxy
earth_timeline.detail: r-process material, including gold, starts entering the interstellar medium within the universe's first ~100 Myr, and continues for billions of years after.

earth_timeline.label: The gas cloud that becomes the Sun is already gold-enriched
earth_timeline.detail: By the time the presolar nebula starts to collapse, ~9.2 billion years of accumulated r-process enrichment is already mixed into it.

earth_timeline.label: Solar system forms (t = 0)
earth_timeline.detail: Pb-Pb dating of calcium-aluminum-rich inclusions (CAIs), the oldest solar system solids, sets this at 4.567 billion years ago.

earth_timeline.label: Earth differentiates: core forms
earth_timeline.detail: Earth is hot and molten enough for dense, iron-loving (siderophile) elements -- including nearly all primordial gold -- to sink into the core.

earth_timeline.label: Moon-forming giant impact (context)
earth_timeline.detail: A Mars-sized body strikes early Earth; the Moon forms from the debris. Mentioned for timeline context, not directly part of the gold story.

earth_timeline.label: The late veneer: leftover planetesimals keep striking Earth
earth_timeline.detail: After core formation is essentially complete, continued bombardment by undifferentiated material adds a thin layer of fresh metal -- including gold -- on top of the already-differentiated mantle.

earth_timeline.label: Present day: late-veneer gold reaches human hands
earth_timeline.detail: Billions of years of geology (hydrothermal veins, placer deposits) concentrate that late-veneer gold into mineable form -- mined, refined, and shaped.
